Services

CSOAI sells measurement, not paperwork. Every service on this page produces a signed record a third party can verify without trusting us.

Compliance measurement

  • GovBench — 193-item, 26-dimension AI compliance benchmark. Measured leaderboard, published harness, public on Hugging Face.
  • ProvBench — EU AI Act Article 50 provenance survival, pre-registered. The measurement that shows what survives the real world.
  • AI Act frozen-split harness — closed-book statutory citation measurement. Public dataset.

Signed attestation

  • Article 50 Passport — free signed transparency record for EU AI Act Article 50 obligations, in about two minutes. Get yours →
  • Living attestation (Pro) — corpus-watch re-fires when the provisions change. See Pricing.
  • Enterprise packs — regulated sector packs, custom frozen splits, auditor access, deployment support.

Advisory & review

  • Pre-deployment audit — measured measurement of your system against the published harnesses, signed record delivered.
  • Red-team honesty — we publish disagreements; we publish disagreement over rounds. No "you passed" theatre.
  • Notified-body liaison — we hand your signed record to a notified body; we do not pretend to be one.

What we do not do

  • Issue accreditations or certifications.
  • Replace legal counsel.
  • Sign "passed" claims without a measurement and a harness.
